steps.en: Install the library into your automation tool
steps.zh: 在自动化工具里装上库

steps.en: Create a client and load the host keys you already trust
steps.zh: 建客户端，加载你已信任的 host key

steps.en: Exchanges keys, verifies the server's host key, authenticates, multiplexes channels
steps.zh: 密钥交换、核验 host key、完成认证，把连接复用成 channel

steps.en: Gives back real file objects per stream; failures are Python exceptions you can catch
steps.zh: 每个流交回真正的文件对象，失败是能被 except 的 Python 异常

value.en: Scripted SSH in-process — commands and SFTP without an ssh binary, quoting hacks, or host-key prompts
value.zh: 命令与文件传输全在进程内——不依赖 ssh 二进制，也没有引号转义和 host-key 提示
